package service

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestCalculateRoadmapUsesExplicitLessonRequirements(t *testing.T) {
	alternativeGroup := "choose-one"
	roadmap := CalculateRoadmap(RoadmapCalculationInput{
		PracticeTask: domain.PracticeTask{
			ID:     "practice-task",
			Stacks: []domain.PracticeTaskStack{{StackCode: "html"}},
		},
		PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{{
			ID:        "milestone",
			StackCode: "html",
			IsActive:  true,
			LessonBindings: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{
				{CourseID: "course", LessonID: "required", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, SortOrder: 10, StepTitle: "Required step"},
				{CourseID: "course", LessonID: "alternative-a", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, SortOrder: 20, AlternativeGroup: &alternativeGroup},
				{CourseID: "course", LessonID: "alternative-b", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, SortOrder: 30, AlternativeGroup: &alternativeGroup},
				{CourseID: "course", LessonID: "recommended", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRecommended, SortOrder: 40},
				{CourseID: "course", LessonID: "optional", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementOptional, SortOrder: 50},
			},
		}},
		CompletedLessonIDs: map[string]struct{}{
			"required":      {},
			"alternative-b": {},
		},
	})

	if len(roadmap.Milestones) != 1 || len(roadmap.Milestones[0].Lessons) != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("expected explicit lessons in roadmap, got %#v", roadmap)
	}
	if roadmap.Milestones[0].Lessons[0].StepTitle != "Required step" {
		t.Fatalf("expected project step metadata, got %#v", roadmap.Milestones[0].Lessons[0])
	}
	if len(roadmap.Stacks) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one stack summary, got %#v", roadmap.Stacks)
	}
	stack := roadmap.Stacks[0]
	if stack.RequiredLessonsCount != 2 || stack.CompletedLessonsCount != 2 || stack.RemainingLessonsCount != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected standalone plus alternative group requirements to be satisfied, got %#v", stack)
	}
	if stack.RecommendedLessonsCount != 1 || stack.OptionalLessonsCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected non-blocking lesson counts, got %#v", stack)
	}
}
